newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Oct 2.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Oct 2.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on its front page on Oct 2:

WASHINGTON - Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Palestinian President Yasser Arafat huddled privately at a White House luncheon that stretched into the afternoon on the first day of talks aimed at ending the recent violence in the Middle East and rescuing the peace process.

WASHINGTON - The Supreme Court entered the emotional debate over physician-assisted suicide, taking two cases that could fundamentally alter the way the legal system recognizes the right to die in America.
WASHINGTON - The number of low-income children in Washington area schools has doubled in the 1990s, a surge that is placing new teaching demands on schools already burdened with budget problems.

WASHINGTON - Teenagers attempting to buy cigarettes illegally at grocery stores, gas stations and other outlets in Maryland went unchallenged by sales clerks more than half the time, according to a new survey.
BALTIMORE - Hollering, high-fiving, hookey-playing Orioles baseball fans flooded Camden Yards bent on savoring the team's first playoff game in 13 years.

WASHINGTON - Reversing earlier opposition, the nation's military chiefs have endorsed a plan to vaccinate all U.S. forces against anthrax in what would be the Pentagon's first regular innoculation program against a germ warfare agent.
